support_structures.basis: Two roof outlines recur in the 2021 and 2025 county orthophotos. The hip and stand-alone post-and-gable types use the photographed annexes on p. 37 of the historic nomination; elevations and opening details are estimates.

interior_landscape_sources.basis: Grave plot edges follow only recurring, visually exposed portions of the aerial traces. Historic photographs guide curb profiles. Internal access follows short open strips and uses the observed mown appearance. The nominal 8-foot plat width is a historic reserve, so the modeled clear strips follow the narrower visible width.

smith_vault.evidence: EPCA tour stop 24 identifies the only above-ground vault just north of Cherry Avenue. The pale oblong hip and two exposed plot edges recur in the registered 2017, 2021 and 2025 county frames. The restoration photograph shows blue-gray plaster and a small plaque on the short face. The height, plaque facing and letter scale are estimates.

memorial_square_kiosk.evidence: The 2017 and 2021 county aerials expose the covered board. The 2025 view is shaded by trees. The association caption and photo establish the 2016 kiosk, board, wood frame, roof and adjacent green sign. Board and sign dimensions are estimates.

rankin_fringe.wall_basis: Preserve elevated west masonry through the existing west span. The central and eastern street views show a low grass verge. Model the photographed short stepped return at the southeast sign.

perimeter_refinement.reference_note: County EPSG:3740 tiles at 10 px/m in the existing ENU frame. Open curb traces and stone centers repeat across dated images. Height, complete construction and stone identity are unverified. Street photographs support the open grass slope, a short stepped concrete return, and low woody planting. The aerials and photos inform geometry only. No image texture is embedded.
